Watts made this hymn from Psalm 20, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you. 2May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion. 3May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah 4May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed. … 5 more verses PSALM 20 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 20
The name of Jacob's God defends Better than shields or brazen walls; He from his sanctuary sends Succour and strength, when Zion calls. STANZA II
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 20. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
